data.name: Horse Spirit Valley
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Horse Spirit Valley
──────────────────────────────
Step into a soft, sunlit fantasy where the rhythm is simple: ride, sparkle, dress up your mount, and unlock new pastures when you’re ready for the next view. No rush—just you, the trail, and a pocket full of dreams.

🐎 Ride & explore
────────────────────
• Third-person horseback adventure across handcrafted 3D valleys—grass, light, and space to breathe.
• Every outing has a honest goal on the HUD: collect every diamond tucked into the world.
• Nail the set and the UI celebrates a full clear—a small victory lap for collectors who love a tidy map.

💎 Diamonds that work for you
──────────────────────────────────
• Gems you pick up stick with you between sessions—your balance is always on screen.
• Sink savings into new environments beyond your starter pasture, or into cosmetic unlocks for your horse.
• Low on glitter? The interface tells you straight—no opaque economy tricks.

🦄 Make the horse unmistakably yours
──────────────────────────────────────────
• Deep dressing room: size, coat, mane style & tint, saddle & reins, armor look & color, horn shape & color.
• Preview everything in the customization hub, save a look you adore, and spend diamonds when a premium style calls your name.

🗺️ Pastures waiting past the horizon
──────────────────────────────────────────
• The map picker shows art, title, and price—play what you own or buy the next dreamscape with saved diamonds.
• Your first world is ready on day one; the rest open when you decide the valley has earned another stamp in your passport.

🌍 Play your way
────────────────────
• Tweak resolution, dial real-time shadows for performance, flip music—this is your session.
• A shuffled soundtrack keeps menus and rides from feeling samey; fairy-tale calm follows you scene to scene.

🎮 Controls that respect the couch
──────────────────────────────────────
• Keyboard & mouse feel natural; gamepad users get menus that behave.
• Pause, adjust, or bounce to the main menu when life interrupts the ride—progress stays where you left it.

🏆 Steam, quietly cheering you on
────────────────────────────────────────
• Achievements reward first rides, diamond milestones, full clears, visiting every map, saving looks, shopping, and coming back for more.

✨ Who it’s for
──────────────────
Horse Spirit Valley is a low-stress, high-satisfaction pocket of magic: wander, shimmer, restyle, unlock, repeat. If gentle fantasy, shiny goals, and a unicorn-worthy mount sound like your kind of Sunday—saddle up.

📣 Stay in the loop
──────────────────────
Wishlists help wandering players find the valley. Thanks for riding along with a small, heartfelt indie adventure.

data.short_description: Ride peaceful 3D valleys on your horse, collect every diamond on the map, and spend your sparkle on new pastures plus deep unicorn-style looks—coats, manes, saddles, armor, and horns—with Steam achievements to chase along the way.
data.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X / Intel UHD 620
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 700 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Playing on minimum requirements should enable to play on Low quality settings in FullHD (1080p) in stable 60 FPS. SSD is recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 700 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Playing on minimum requirements should enable to play on Low quality settings in FullHD (1080p) in stable 60 FPS. SSD is recommended.
